newsitem.title: USA: Kaman in deal with McDonnell Douglas.
newsitem.headline: Kaman in deal with McDonnell Douglas.

text.p: Kaman Aerospace Corp said Thursday it received orders valued at $14.9 million from McDonnell Douglas for parts for its C-17 Globemaster III military transport.
In a separate order worth $1.9 million, Kaman will produce parts for C-17 electrical boxes and ship them as kits to McDonnell Douglas' plant in Macon, Georgia.
Kaman said these latest orders bring the value of all contracts it has received for C-17 work to about $67 million.
The U.S. Air Force currently has a requirement for 120 C-17 transports.
Kaman Aerospace is a subsidiary of Kaman Corp, based in Bloomfield, Conn.
